plan.description: With requirementId and a complete candidate: the hash-bound kibi.compile-plan.v1 that writes the predicate fact and links requires_predicate in one kb_apply_plan call (approvedPlanHash = plan.planHash). Its contradictionAnalysis is the what-if over the current KB plus the plan; a conflict leaves the plan blocked. Null when no plan applies.

relationshipTarget.description: The planned predicate fact id (FACT-PRED-...) that a requires_predicate link must target. Candidate ids (SUGGEST-...) are never relationship targets.

existingGrounding.description: The grounding links requirementId already has for this claim: matched by claim_key (the same proposition text) or, for a predicate fact, by the recommended candidate's canonical_key (the same predicate tuple in other words; matchedBy says which).

decisionConflicts.description: When no hash-bound plan ran the contradiction analysis: stored decision facts of current requirements that agree with the complete candidate on its key arguments and decide the opposite (requirementId, factId, effect, proposedEffect, canonicalKey). A warning repeats each one.

bindingHints.description: On provide_argument_bindings: one entry per unbound argument of the recommended candidate with its type, declared constants (allowedValues) when the vocabulary is closed, schema example values and the reason the current value was not accepted. Empty otherwise.

pluginOffers.description: Optional plugins that fit this workspace and that the project has neither activated nor declined. Ask the operator; on yes install and activate the package, on no add it to package.json kibi.declinedPlugins.

kb_upsert.description: Committed upsert payload, or the validation preview when dryRun:true wrote nothing.

claimKey.description: For a fact with claim_text: the stored claim_key, derived from claim_text when the payload did not supply it.

outcome.description: Absent on a direct delete. plan_returned: deletionPlan was returned and nothing was written; nextActions[0].input is the exact kb_apply_plan input. supersession_required: an authored requirement must be superseded with kb_upsert instead. plan_applied: approvedPlanHash matched and the plan was applied. dry_run: dryRun:true previewed the delete and nothing was written.

kb_check.description: Synchronous check payload, or a kibi.job.v1 receipt when async:true detached the check into a background job (poll kb_job_status with the jobId).

kb_apply_plan.description: Synchronous apply result, or a kibi.job.v1 receipt when async:true detached the apply into a background job (poll kb_job_status with the jobId).
